== Acquisition ==
This skill is given to Grenth players in a [[Dwayna Vs Grenth]] match, as well as in [[The Great Snowball Fight of the Gods (PvP)|The Great Snowball Fight of the Gods]] and certain repeatable [[Wintersday]] quests.

== Notes ==
* This skill is only available to players during Wintersday events.
* This skill is used by [[Grentch (summon)|Grentch]] from summoning stones.

== Trivia ==
* The name of this skill likely revolves around [[w:toilet humor|toilet humor]].
{{Anomaly|When used by a [[Ranger]], the skill activation animation is used, instead of a preparation animation.}}
